definition: In psychology, “borderline” usually refers to borderline personality disorder, a mental health condition linked with intense emotional upheaval, major relationship distress, and episodes of suicidal or other self-harming behavior that can lead to crisis care. It is associated with substantial clinical severity and a heightened risk of suicide.
